rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when you temporarily give an item or money to someone to return.

example.english: Can you lend me your umbrella? I’ll return it tomorrow.
example.traditional: 可唔可以借畀我把遮，聽日還你？
example.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 bei2 ngo5 baa2 ze1 ting1 jat6 waan4 nei5

rows.note: Use this when “lend” means to furnish or make assistance, resources, or facilities available.

example.english: The school can lend us a venue for the event.
example.traditional: 間學校會提供場地畀我哋搞活動。
example.jyutping: gaan1 hok6 haau6 wui5 tai4 gung1 coeng4 dei6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 gaau2 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when something is suitable or applicable for a particular use, such as translation.

example.english: This wording can lend itself to everyday conversation.
example.traditional: 呢個講法適合日常對話。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 sik1 hap6 jat6 soeng4 deoi3 waa6
